title: Satu Biji Lagi
subject: a grandmother in Kuala Kangsar who has never lost a game of congkak, and the twenty-eight-year-old grandson who practises on a phone app on the LRT for three months to beat her on a Sunday visit
caption: Electro-swing pop, light and bouncing, a sung pop song on a swung house beat. A four-on-the-floor house kick with off-beat open hi-hats and a hand clap on two and four; an acoustic piano bouncing swung eighth-note chords and short fills; a brass section of trumpet, trombone and tenor saxophone punching short unison stabs between the lines; a plucked upright bass pumping under a light sidechain; a clean hollow-body electric guitar comping on the off-beats. Clean, punchy modern mix, kick and piano forward, brass tight and close, a short room reverb. Male tenor, warm and smiling, light conversational phrasing, crisp on the swung syllables. 126 BPM, F major. Cheerful, competitive and fond. No vintage mono sound, no walking bass, no brushed drums, no EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - piano and a brass stab, house kick enters]

[Verse 1]
Ahad pagi, rumah nenek di Kuala Kangsar
Papan congkak bentuk perahu, kayu cengal
Tujuh lubang sebelah, rumah kat hujung
Nenek senyum, "Nak kalah lagi ke?"

[Pre-Chorus]
Tiga bulan aku berlatih dalam LRT
Lawan app dalam telefon, app pun dah kalah

[Chorus]
Nenek tak pernah kalah
Tangan laju, mata tak berkelip
Aku baru nak kira, dia dah habis kira
Nenek tak pernah kalah, nak main lagi?

[Verse 2]
Biji getah dia simpan dalam tin biskut
Tin Khong Guan, penutupnya dah kemek
Pusingan kedua aku hampir menang
Dia batuk sikit, kiraan aku lari

[Chorus]
Nenek tak pernah kalah
Batuk sikit, tangan dah sampai rumah
Aku baru nak kira, dia dah habis kira
Nenek tak pernah kalah, nak main lagi?

[Bridge - brass and piano trade fills]
Pusingan ketiga, tinggal satu biji
Satu biji je, aku kalah satu biji

[Chorus]
Nenek tak pernah kalah
Tapi hari ni dia tepuk bahu aku
"Satu biji lagi, cu," katanya sambil gelak
Nenek tak pernah kalah, Ahad depan lagi

[Outro - brass stab and piano tag]
